text:
Samir Rao: heads-up — CloudSI says their PTP billing feed dropped ~2 hours of records yesterday (no acks). they replayed but we saw duplicates and some late entitlements. can we agree a partner-facing retry/backfill strategy? :thinking:

Jon Keene: do we know if the partner sends a stable partner_event_id? dedupe should use that plus payload hash.

cloud-si-contact: yep, we include partner_event_id and sequence_number. onboard doc shows optional `batch_id` too. replay used the same event ids.

Priya Desai: recommendation from PM: (1) require partner_event_id for all billable events, (2) server-side dedupe window = 30 days, (3) retry policy: exponential backoff up to 4 retries then mark as delayed and surface to ops.

Mike O'Neill: implementation notes from infra — we can add a lightweight at-ingest dedupe layer and idempotency index. proposal: `max_retries=4`, backoff ms: [30s, 2m, 8m, 30m], then move to `pending_backfill` queue. also create alert if pending_backfill count > 10 for a partner.

Clara Ruiz: finance point — when events are late we need provisional credits on the partner ledger to avoid customer invoice drift. process: auto-provision credits for missing window after 1 hour, reconcile after successful backfill. need sign-off from legal on contract language for provisional credits.

Samir Rao: sounds reasonable. couple of edge cases: (a) partner replays with modified amount for same partner_event_id — we should keep last-write-wins but log original for audit, (b) sequence_number gaps should not cause permanent rejection — allow out-of-order up to 100 seq gap and reconcile on final commit.

Jon Keene: agree on last-write-wins + audit trail. sample dedupe query for analytics team:```sql
SELECT partner_event_id, max(received_at) as last_received, count(*) as attempts
FROM billing_ingest
WHERE partner_id = 'cloudsi-123'
GROUP BY partner_event_id
HAVING count(*) > 1;
```

Priya Desai: operational playbook sketch: 1) automated retries as Mike outlined, 2) billing-bot posts to #partnerships on >3 pending_backfill events for partner, 3) run nightly backfill job with `backfill_window=7d`, 4) if backfill fails, raise SEV for partner ops.

billing-bot: scheduled retry job enqueued for partner cloudsi-123 (next run in 30s) :gear:

cloud-si-contact: we will implement jitter and align to your backoff windows. also can start adding `payload_hash` to each event to help dedupe.

Mike O'Neill: one more infra detail — to avoid double-billing during backfill, we'll mark backfill-applied events with a reconciliation_run_id and block consumer that turns events into invoice line items until reconciliation_run_id is present.

Clara Ruiz: please add `reconciliation_run_id` to the ingested schema and expose a small CSV report for finance when backfill completes.

Samir Rao: next steps: Priya to draft the partner-facing retry/backfill SLAs and update onboarding checklist. Jon/Mike to scope dedupe index + backfill queue. Clara to draft provisional credit flow and legal check. I'll coordinate with CloudSI for ETA. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Priya Desai: I'll post a short doc in /shared/partnerships with the exact config values and a runbook link by EOD.

Jon Keene: tagging infra task: `INFRA-7425` to add idempotency index + pending_backfill monitor.

Mike O'Neill: noted. will add alert and a dashboard panel for pending_backfill count per partner.

cloud-si-contact: ETA for partner-side changes ~48 hours. will confirm when jitter + payload_hash are in place.

Samir Rao: great — marking this thread done for sync. follow-ups in the doc.
